tool: grok 1.0.77, headless (-p) with its image generation tool
command: grok -p "Use your image generation tool to create one image. Subject: <subject> Style: <style> Save it in the current directory as image.png. Do not write code to draw it; use image generation. Reply with the saved file path only." --permission-mode bypassPermissions --max-turns 12
